newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia LKT Industrial in bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia LKT Industrial in bonus issue.

text.p: Malaysian company LKT Industrial Bhd said it is planning a bonus issue of 11.99 million new shares on the basis of three new shares for every five existing shares.
In a statement sent late on Monday, the maker of precision, high-technology equipment said the bonus issue would be based on the company's issued and paid-up share capital of 19.99 million shares.
It said the bonus issue will increase its issued and paid-up share capital "to better reflect the assets employed" in its current level of operations.
The bonus issue will expand LKT's share capital to 31.99 million shares. Upon completion of the issue, its net tangible assets will fall to 1.17 ringgit a share from 1.86 ringgit, it said.

LKT also said in the same statement that it plans to establish an employee share option scheme for eligible staff. The number of new shares to be offered under this plan will be a maximum of 10 percent of its issued and paid-up share capital, LKT said. (( -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom 603 201 4813))
